message.factorycraft.crane.not_seated: Sit in a crane to use the control
message.factorycraft.engine.no_fuel: Out of fuel! Right-click the machine with coal
message.factorycraft.upgrade.wrong_machi: This module doesn't fit this machine
upgrade.factorycraft.hybrid_engine.desc: No fuel while idling, 25% less while driving
upgrade.factorycraft.solar_panel.desc: Charges the tank in daylight under open sky
upgrade.factorycraft.wide_drill.desc: Bigger work area (excavator, tunneler, paver, harvester)
upgrade.factorycraft.fortune.desc: Mines and harvests with Fortune III (excavator, tunneler, harvester)
upgrade.factorycraft.ore_filter.desc: Throws away stone, dirt and gravel; keeps ores (excavator, tunneler)
upgrade.factorycraft.magnet.desc: Collects loose items from 8 blocks away (dump truck)
message.factorycraft.tanker.cant: The tank is full or holds another fluid
message.factorycraft.drone.none: No drone deployed — right-click a Scout Drone to launch it
guide.factorycraft.intro.title: Getting started
guide.factorycraft.intro.text:
FactoryCraft adds heavy machinery, a powered factory and logistics.

Suggested path:
1. Excavator or tunneler plus a dump truck to mine.
2. Belts, crusher and industrial furnace to process.
3. Diesel generator and press: plates and gears unlock upgrade modules and advanced machines.
4. Robot arms, pumps and a locomotive to automate.

Driveable machines are placed with their item (right-click the ground) and seat you. Hit them to break them.
guide.factorycraft.engine.title: Engine and fuel
guide.factorycraft.engine.text:
Controls: W/S drive and reverse, A/D steer. Shift to get out.

The engine starts when you get in and stops when you leave. Key R: engine on/off (rebindable in Controls). With the engine off the machine can't move, work or light up.

Fuel: right-click the machine with coal, charcoal, wood, a lava bucket... (sneak = whole stack). One coal lasts ~80 s driving, ~5 min idling. Machines with a bay burn coal, coal blocks and blaze rods stored in it.

The dashboard (bottom left) shows engine, fuel, modules and extra info. Headlights: key H switches between Auto (night and underground), On and Off.
guide.factorycraft.upgrades.title: Upgrade modules
guide.factorycraft.upgrades.text:
Sneak + right-click a machine (or the inventory key while seated) opens its screen: the 4 module slots and the fuel gauge are on the left. Put modules in or take them out there. You can also install them by right-clicking the machine, and the wrench removes them all.

- Turbo: +35% speed, +50% fuel use.
- Efficient engine: -40% fuel use.
- Hybrid engine: no fuel while idling, -25% while driving.
- Solar panel: charges in daylight under open sky.
- Big tank: doubles the tank.
- Wide drill: bigger work area (excavator, tunneler, paver, harvester, bulldozer, forester, tanker).
- Fortune: Fortune III (excavator, tunneler, harvester, forester).
- Ore filter: discards stone, dirt, gravel (excavator, tunneler).
- Magnet: the dump truck collects items 8 blocks away.

Recipe: iron plates, gold, redstone and a key item in the middle.
guide.factorycraft.excavator.title: Excavator
guide.factorycraft.excavator.text:
Drives forward breaking a face 8 wide, 6 high and 4 deep.

What it breaks goes straight into a dump truck within 16 blocks; otherwise it drops.

Great for flattening hills and opening quarries.
guide.factorycraft.tunneler.title: Tunneler and wagons
guide.factorycraft.tunneler.text:
Bores exactly the space it will occupy. Look up or down while driving to tilt it (up to 50°) and dig ramps. Works underwater.

Own 27-slot bay (sneak + right-click). Dug blocks fill its bay, then the wagons, then a nearby dump truck.

Cargo wagons: place them behind the tunneler (or locomotive) and they hitch on their own; each holds 54 items. Right-click to open.

G key (rebindable): switches the drill on or off. Off, it doesn't turn or dig: handy for driving through finished tunnels without breaking anything.
guide.factorycraft.dump_truck.title: Dump truck
guide.factorycraft.dump_truck.text:
81 slots (sneak + right-click). Collects loose items around it and receives what nearby excavators and tunnelers break.

To unload: park with its rear against a chest, hopper or belt and get out. It tips the bed and empties.
guide.factorycraft.paver.title: Road paver
guide.factorycraft.paver.text: Clears a 3-wide, 3-high corridor and paves the floor with the first solid block in its bay (stone bricks, concrete...). Without blocks it only levels.
guide.factorycraft.harvester.title: Combine harvester
guide.factorycraft.harvester.text: Harvests a 5-wide strip: ripe crops (replanted), nether wart, melons, pumpkins, sugar cane, bamboo and cactus (base left). Unripe crops are left alone.
guide.factorycraft.bulldozer.title: Bulldozer
guide.factorycraft.bulldozer.text: Its blade levels a 5-wide strip at track height: scrapes everything up to 4 high and fills holes (to the bottom, up to 32 deep, bottom up, water included) with the dirt and rubble it collected. Drive over rough land and it leaves it flat.
guide.factorycraft.tanker.title: Tanker truck
guide.factorycraft.tanker.text:
Carries up to 128 buckets of water or lava.

Seated, right-click the tanker with an empty hand to switch mode:
- Transport: nothing.
- Drain: sucks up source blocks ahead while driving.
- Fill: pours sources into the holes ahead.

Buckets: empty to take, full to pour in.

Fuel station: carrying lava, it refuels every machine within 8 blocks.
guide.factorycraft.forester.title: Forestry harvester
guide.factorycraft.forester.text:
Driving into a tree fells it whole (logs and natural leaves, so you get saplings and apples) and plants a sapling from its bay. Leaves wooden buildings without natural leaves alone.

G key (rebindable): switches the saw on or off. Off, it doesn't turn or fell: drive between trees without cutting them.
guide.factorycraft.crane.title: Crawler crane
guide.factorycraft.crane.text:
Seated, with the Crane Control:
- Right-click a block: lift the cube whose bottom centre is that block.
- Right-click elsewhere: set it down against that face.
- Right-click the air: size 1, 3 or 5.

The load turns with the crane. Chests keep their contents. Reach 24 blocks (target within 18 of the crane).
guide.factorycraft.tower_crane.title: Tower crane
guide.factorycraft.tower_crane.text: Stationary, 17 blocks tall. A/D slew it around the tower. Used with the Crane Control like the crawler crane, but reaches 40 blocks and lifts up to 20×20×20 (8,000 blocks). Right-click the air to change the size: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 12, 16 or 20.
guide.factorycraft.locomotive.title: Locomotive
guide.factorycraft.locomotive.text:
On rails it steers itself (curves and slopes) and runs fast; off rails it is slow.

With rails in its bay it lays track ahead as you drive: build a line just by driving.

Cargo wagons hitch behind it.
guide.factorycraft.drone.title: Scout drone
guide.factorycraft.drone.text:
Right-click with the drone to launch it.

With the Drone Controller:
- Right-click: it flies where you look (up to 96 blocks) and scans for ores within 16. They glow through walls in their own colour for 30 s.
- Sneak + right-click: it returns to your inventory.

Right-click the drone to pick it up.
guide.factorycraft.belts.title: Belts, sorter and elevator
guide.factorycraft.belts.text:
Belt: moves items, mobs and players the way it faces and feeds the container at its end. Slopes and curves are automatic: place the next one a block higher/lower, or sideways.

Sorter: filtered items leave to the LEFT. Right-click with an item = filter; sneak + empty hand = clear.

Elevator: stack them in a column; everything rises and leaves the top block through its front.

Fast (twice as fast) and express (over three times) conveyors. They mix with normal belts.
guide.factorycraft.processing.title: Crusher and industrial furnace
guide.factorycraft.processing.text:
Machines send products out of their FRONT onto a belt or container. Right-click opens their screen.

Crusher: raw ores give double dust (x4 from ore blocks), stone -> gravel -> sand, bones -> bone meal, etc. Needs no power. It has 6 inputs and 8 outputs and crushes one item from every input at once.

Industrial furnace: smelts 8 at a time every 2 seconds (about 12 times a furnace's speed), same fuel per item. Smelts dusts into ingots.

Machine upgrades (crusher, industrial furnace and powered machines): right-click to install, up to 4 per machine. Speed: -30% time. Efficiency: -30% energy or fuel. Output: 25% chance of double results. They stack. The wrench takes them out. Installed upgrades show in the screen's title.
guide.factorycraft.well_drill.title: Well drill
guide.factorycraft.well_drill.text: Bores a 3×3 shaft straight down to bedrock and keeps everything in its 27 slots (right-click). Products leave through its front. A redstone signal pauses it.
guide.factorycraft.power.title: Power: generators and cables
guide.factorycraft.power.text:
Diesel generator: burns any fuel (also lava through pipes) and stores up to 100,000 E. One coal = 64,000 E. It only burns when it has room.

Solar generator: free power by day if it sees the sky (16 E/t; less in rain, none at night or in storms). Stores 40,000 E and is also a charging station:
- Put a drill in its slot and it charges.
- Machines parked within 4 blocks get refuelled (40 E = 1 fuel).
It powers machines through cables like the diesel one.

Big battery: stores 10,000,000 E. It charges itself with spare power from the generators on its network and gives it back when they can't keep up (e.g. solar power at night). It also charges tools in its slot.

Energy meter: right-click a cable, generator or machine to see the whole network: generators, what they make, stored energy, batteries and machines.

Cables: connect generators to powered machines. A machine touching a generator is powered too. In the screens, the blue bar is the available energy.

Clean power (no fuel):
- Windmill: more power the higher it is (from Y 64, up to 50 E/t) with open air around it. Rain x1.5, storms x2.
- Geothermal generator: 15 E/t for every lava source touching it (up to 90 E/t).
- Steam turbine: touching a reactor, turns its steam into half again as much power and cools it. Up to 4 per reactor.

Copper:
- Copper coil (1 copper block + 1 iron ingot = 2): used by the windmill, turbine, geothermal generator, battery and jetpack.
- Copper radiator: put it on the reactor's faces; each one keeps shedding heat.
- Lightning collector: put a lightning rod on top. Every bolt that hits it stores 1,000,000 E (up to 4,000,000). In storms the rod attracts lightning.
- The press turns 1 copper, iron or gold block into 9 plates.
- The Mechanic buys 3 copper blocks for 2 emeralds.

Other mods: power is standard FE (1 = 1). Other mods' generators can run our machines, and they can draw from our generators, reactor and batteries. Our generators also push power into touching machines from other mods. Other mods' pipes and conveyors fill and empty our machines and vehicles, and can feed water to the reactor. Recipes accept plates, gears and ingots from other mods (common tags), and the crusher grinds other mods' ores into their dust.
guide.factorycraft.powered.title: Powered machines
guide.factorycraft.powered.text:
Ore washer: gravel, sand, dirt, mud... give nuggets, dusts, flint, clay. 6 inputs and 8 outputs: washes one from every input at once.

Press: ingot -> plate (iron, copper, gold), 2 iron plates -> gear, sugar cane -> paper, packed ice, 64 coal -> diamond.

Mixer: dye + 4 sand + 4 gravel = 8 concrete powder; with water touching it, solid concrete.

Packager: 9 ingots -> block, 9 nuggets -> ingot, 4 quartz -> block, etc.

Repair station: with power, repairs the tools and armor in its 4 inputs and puts them out like new. It also repairs what players within 6 blocks hold and wear, while they work.

Tannery: turns rotten flesh into leather (2 = 1) and rabbit hide into leather (4 = 1). Two inputs working at once. Without the machine, rotten flesh also cures into leather in a smoker or on a campfire (slower).

Incinerator: destroys whatever goes in (by hand, hopper or belt), one item from each of its 4 slots every half second. Needs no power, but its smoke pollutes like a diesel generator unless an air purifier or a chimney filter is nearby.

Terrain filler: fills every hole, pond, ravine and crater around it up to the level it stands on, bottom up, leaving no gaps. Works column by column (up to 96 deep) with the dirt, stone or rubble in its 6 slots. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand changes the area: 9×9, 17×17, 33×33 or 49×49 (marked with particles). Caves sealed under solid ground are left alone. Each block uses 30 energy. When done it keeps watch: new holes get filled too.
guide.factorycraft.automation.title: Robot arm, pump and pipes
guide.factorycraft.automation.text:
Robot arm: takes from BEHIND (container or belt) and puts it in FRONT. Uses power. Filter like the sorter.

Pump: place it touching water or lava; it empties the whole body. Sends it through pipes to empty cauldrons, generators (lava) or a tanker parked against a pipe. Right-click: status; sneak + right-click: drain mode (discards the fluid).
guide.factorycraft.station.title: Control station
guide.factorycraft.station.text: Right-click: lists all machines within 256 blocks with engine, fuel, cargo and position, plus nearby generators with their charge. Mouse wheel scrolls.
guide.factorycraft.tools.title: Tools
guide.factorycraft.tools.text:
Hammers: mine a 3×3 area at once, facing the way you look (wall, floor or ceiling). Each extra block costs durability, and only blocks the hammer can mine are broken.
Excavating shovels: the same with dirt, sand, gravel, snow, clay... Right-click still makes paths.
Sneak to break a single block with hammers and shovels.
Electric drills: without charge they are normal pickaxes. Charged, they mine twice as fast and have:
- Vein mode: breaking an ore breaks the whole connected vein (up to 64).
- Tunnel mode: digs a 1×2 passage 3 deep (or a shaft when looking up/down).
- Sneak + right-click: scanner, ores within 8 blocks glow for 10 s.
Right-click the air to switch modes. Charge it by right-clicking a generator (diesel or solar), or leave it in the solar generator's slot.
Chainsaws: cutting a log fells the whole tree (natural trees only, with leaves). Sneak to cut a single block.

Stone, copper, iron, diamond and netherite versions. Copper sits between stone and iron: faster than stone, a bit cheaper than iron.

Wrench: removes upgrade modules.
Crane Control and Drone Controller: see their chapters.

Giant excavation drill: the next tier after the prototype. x4 battery, 256-block veins and a 5×5 tunnel 4 deep.
Jetpack: wear it and hold jump in the air to fly (uses energy; no fall damage). Charged like the drill.
Magnet backpack: right-click to turn it on; while in your inventory it pulls items within 8 blocks.
Industrial chest: 108 slots, works with belts, hoppers and arms. Use the wrench to turn on its filter: it then only accepts what it already holds.
message.factorycraft.drill.no_charge: The drill doesn't have enough charge
tooltip.factorycraft.drill.help: Right-click: mode · Sneak+right-click: scan · Right-click a generator: charge
upgrade.factorycraft.fortune_ii.desc: Mines and harvests with Fortune IV
guide.factorycraft.mechanic.title: The Mechanic
guide.factorycraft.mechanic.text:
Place a Mechanic's Bench near a jobless villager and it becomes a Mechanic (yellow hard hat, hi-vis vest).

Level 1: buys coal; sells iron plates and cables.
Level 2: buys copper; sells gears, pipes and the wrench.
Level 3: sells modules (Turbo, Efficient, Solar, Magnet).
Level 4: special versions for emeralds + the diamond tool:
- Prototype drill: 128-block veins, 3×3 tunnel, double battery.
- Industrial chainsaw: giant trees, clears the leaves too.
- Titan hammer: mines 5×5.
Level 5: exclusive modules:
- Turbo II: +70% speed.
- Fortune IV.
- Fusion engine: no fuel, takes 2 slots (needs a Nether Star).

Each Mechanic offers a random selection: keep several to find what you need.
upgrade.factorycraft.nuclear_engine.desc: Burns 95% less fuel and gives +20% speed. Takes 2 slots
tooltip.factorycraft.gamma_rifle.help: Right-click: fire · Right-click a generator or reactor: charge
tooltip.factorycraft.irradiated_blade.he: Charged: +8 damage and Wither · Right-click a generator or reactor: charge
tooltip.factorycraft.mini_nuke.help: Right-click: throw. Huge blast and a radioactive cloud
guide.factorycraft.nuclear.title: Radioactive ores
guide.factorycraft.nuclear.text:
Three new ores underground:
- Lead (Y -16 to 64, common): not radioactive. Used for shielding: lead armor and the reactor.
- Thorium (Y -32 to 48): low-power radioactive. Cheap, safe fuel.
- Uranium (below Y 0, rare, glows faintly): the main fuel.
Process them like iron: crusher (x2 dust, x4 from the ore), furnace or blast furnace, or smelt the raw ore.

Plutonium: the strongest. It isn't found in the world: wash depleted rods in the ore washer for nuggets. 9 nuggets = 1 ingot.

☢ Radiation: carrying radioactive materials makes you sick (hunger, nausea, weakness, poison and, with a lot, Wither). Each lead armor piece blocks 25%; the full suit makes you immune. A warning shows on screen.

Waste: washing depleted rods leaves Nuclear Waste (very radioactive). Store it in a Lead Waste Barrel; dropped on the ground it contaminates the soil. Geiger Counter: hold it and it clicks faster the more radiation is around.
guide.factorycraft.reactor.title: Nuclear reactor
guide.factorycraft.reactor.text:
Burns fuel rods (press: 4 thorium or uranium ingots, or 2 plutonium = 1 rod):
- Thorium: 80 E/t, 480,000 E per rod.
- Uranium: 200 E/t, 2,000,000 E per rod.
- Plutonium: 500 E/t, 6,000,000 E per rod.
Stores up to 2,000,000 E and powers machines through cables. Depleted rods come out the front.

COOLING: it needs water (right-click with buckets, or a pump and pipes; holds 16 buckets). While running it heats up and uses water. Without water the heat climbs to 100% and the reactor MELTS DOWN: a huge explosion and a radioactive cloud. Above 70% heat it smokes and sounds an alarm.

Redstone signal = emergency shutdown: it stops burning at once and cools off.

(Server owners can make blasts not break blocks in factorycraft-server.toml.)

Nuclear Engine module for vehicles: 95% less fuel and +20% speed. Takes 2 slots.
guide.factorycraft.weapons.title: Nuclear weapons
guide.factorycraft.weapons.text:
Gamma rifle: fires a 48-block radiation beam that hits the first creature (14 damage + Wither). Runs on energy: 40 shots per full charge.

Irradiated blade: a netherite sword with a uranium core. Charged, every hit deals +8 damage and applies Wither.

To charge them: right-click a generator (diesel or solar) or the reactor, or leave them in the solar generator's slot. The green bar shows the charge.

Mini-nuke: throw it with right-click. It blows up and leaves a radioactive cloud. Don't throw it close!

Its power depends on the core you build it with:
- Grade I uranium: 18-block crater radius.
- Grade II: 28 blocks.
- Grade III: 40 blocks.
- Plutonium: 58 blocks; wipes out the landscape.
The shock wave reaches twice the radius: it throws, burns and blinds everything in it, walls or not. Around the crater leaves, glass and wood are blown away, the rim burns and a mushroom cloud rises, visible from far away. The crater is carved over a few seconds. Blasted blocks drop nothing.
Throw it from far away!
Uranium is enriched in the centrifuge: 4 uranium dust = Grade I, 4 Grade I = Grade II, 4 Grade II = Grade III. Each step takes time and power, so a strong bomb costs a lot of uranium.
tooltip.factorycraft.machine_upgrade.hel: Right-click a processing machine to install (max 4). The wrench takes them out.
message.factorycraft.meter.title: === Power network ===
message.factorycraft.meter.none: No generators or batteries on this network!
inspector.factorycraft.title: === Inspection: %s ===
inspector.factorycraft.reactor.shielding: Shielding: %s of %s blocks (lead, concrete or obsidian around it)
inspector.factorycraft.reactor.scram: Emergency shutdown lever or button next to the reactor
inspector.factorycraft.diesel.filter: Chimney filter on top (or a purifier nearby)
inspector.factorycraft.result.bad: Things to fix: %s of %s in order
guide.factorycraft.clean_power.title: Clean power plants
guide.factorycraft.clean_power.text:
Badly built plants harm the environment:
- Diesel smoke without a filter: dries grass, kills flowers and strips leaves within 10 blocks.
- Radiation: an unshielded reactor, waste left on the ground, meltdowns and bombs turn the ground into contaminated soil (glows green). Walking on it makes you sick; lead boots protect.

HOW TO BUILD A PROPER PLANT

1. Choose the power for the place:
- Solar: by day, under open sky.
- Windmill: high up (ideally above Y 100) with no blocks around.
- Geothermal: touching lava sources, clean and endless.
- Diesel: always with a filter.
- Nuclear: the strongest, but follow the whole protocol.

2. Diesel: put a Chimney Filter on top of every generator. Then it doesn't pollute.

3. Nuclear reactor, step by step:
a) Build a concrete or lead floor.
b) Surround the reactor: at least 16 of the 26 blocks around it must be shielding (lead block, concrete or obsidian). Leave gaps only for pipes, cables and turbines.
c) Water: a pump with pipes from a lake or well, and keep at least 4 buckets inside.
d) Steam turbines touching the reactor: more power and less heat.
e) Put a lever next to the reactor: it's the emergency shutdown.
f) Put a Lead Waste Barrel nearby and send the washer's waste into it with a hopper or belt. Never drop waste on the ground.
g) Put an Air Purifier in the area.

4. Check it with the Plant Inspector: right-click the reactor or generator. All ✔ means a clean, safe plant.

5. If there's already contamination: find it with the Geiger Counter and clean it with the Decontamination Kit (5×5 per use) or an Air Purifier (cleans by itself, 12 blocks around). Contaminated soil also recovers on its own, very slowly.

(Server owners can turn pollution off or down in factorycraft-server.toml.)
message.factorycraft.chest.filter_on: Filter on: only accepts what it already holds
tooltip.factorycraft.jetpack.help: Wear it on your chest. Hold jump in the air to fly. Right-click a generator: charge
upgrade.factorycraft.autopilot.desc: With no driver, follows route beacons 1 → 2 → 3...
guide.factorycraft.logistics.title: Logistics and autopilot
guide.factorycraft.logistics.text:
Loading and Unloading Stations: put them beside the track (or where trucks park) with a chest or industrial chest touching them. The loading station moves items from the chest into wagons and trucks within 3 blocks; the unloading station empties them into the chest. 32 items every half second.

Tank wagon: hitches like the cargo wagon and carries 128 buckets of water or lava. Pumps fill it through pipes; the unloading station empties it into a reactor (water), a diesel generator (lava) or a cauldron.

Autopilot: install the module in a dump truck or work machine. Place Route Beacons and number them with right-click (1, 2, 3...). When you get out, the vehicle drives 1 → 2 → 3... and back to 1 by itself. Sneak + right-click makes a beacon a STOP: the vehicle waits 10 s there (a truck unloads if a chest is behind it). Get in to take control again.
A locomotive with autopilot follows the track by itself and stops at stop beacons beside the track.
guide.factorycraft.aircraft.title: Helicopter and submarine
guide.factorycraft.aircraft.text:
Controls: W/S/A/D as usual, JUMP to go up and SPRINT (Ctrl) to go down.

Cargo helicopter: flies and lifts structures like the crane (with the Crane Control: right-click the structure below to lift it, and again to drop it), up to 7×7×7. With the engine off it glides down.

Mining submarine: moves freely underwater and its drill opens a 3×3 hole as it advances, storing what it mines in its 27-slot bay (sneak + right-click). The pilot breathes inside. Out of water it crawls slowly.
message.factorycraft.tool_off: Tool off: it stops turning and cutting
message.factorycraft.blueprint.corner: First corner set. Right-click the opposite corner.
message.factorycraft.blueprint.too_big: Too big: at most %s blocks per side and %s blocks in all
tooltip.factorycraft.blueprint.empty: Empty: right-click two opposite corners to copy
guide.factorycraft.terrain.title: Terrain and building
guide.factorycraft.terrain.text:
Stationary machines that work a square area around them. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand changes the size (marked with particles). They all use power and, once done, re-check the area every 10 seconds.

Leveller: cuts away everything above its level (hills, trees, buildings without chests), top down, up to 64 high. What it cuts goes out the front onto a belt or into a chest. With the terrain filler it leaves a perfectly flat plain.

Quarry: digs its area layer by layer from under itself down to bedrock and sends everything out the front, ores included. Leaves fluids and chests alone.

Drain pump: empties water and lava from the area, from 8 above its level to 32 below. Also dries waterlogged blocks. Use it before filling or building in a lake.

Tree planter: replants the area with the saplings in its 6 slots, one every 3 blocks, on grass or dirt.

Blueprint and builder: with the blueprint, right-click one corner of a building and then the opposite corner (up to 32×32×32). Put the blueprint in the builder's first slot and the blocks in the others: it builds it in front of itself (the panel side), bottom up. Missing a block, it waits for you to add it. It never breaks anything: taken spots are skipped. Sneak + right-click the air clears the blueprint.

Industrial lamp: full brightness. With power (5 per tick) it stops monsters spawning within 32 blocks.

Bridges: the paver already lays road over water and ravines as it drives, with the block it has loaded.
guide.factorycraft.materials.title: Materials and alloys
guide.factorycraft.materials.text:
Four new metals underground (processed like iron: crusher x2, furnace, blast furnace):
- Tin (Y -16 to 96, common).
- Nickel (Y -48 to 48).
- Lithium (Y -64 to 16, scarce, lilac): for batteries and advanced circuits.
- Tungsten (Y -64 to -16, rare, dark; needs an iron pickaxe): the hard metal.

Alloy smelter (power): melts two ingredients together, in either order.
- Steel: 1 iron ingot + 2 coal (or 1 iron dust + 1 coal). Also in a blast furnace from iron dust, slower.
- Bronze: 3 copper + 1 tin = 4.
- Stainless steel: 3 steel + 1 nickel = 4.
- Plastic: 4 dried kelp + 1 coal, or 1 slime ball + 1 coal = 2 sheets.
- Tempered glass: 4 glass + 1 steel = 4. Blast-resistant like obsidian.
The press makes steel, bronze and stainless plates, and 4 copper wires from a copper plate.

Circuits: 2 wires + 2 redstone + 1 plastic = 2 circuit boards. Advanced circuit: gold plates, quartz, circuits and lithium.

Accepts ingots and dusts from other mods through common tags (another mod's tin works for bronze, for example).
guide.factorycraft.exotic.title: Nether and End
guide.factorycraft.exotic.text:
Materials one tier above the overworld metals.

Nether (heat and power):
- Igneous ore (Y 10 to 40, glows): gives igneous crystal, for tools that smelt what they mine and resist fire.
- Sulfur ore (common): gives 2 to 4 sulfur. 2 sulfur + 1 coal = 3 gunpowder. Also a fuel.
- Infernal cobalt ore (Y 8 to 32, rare, iron pickaxe): the Nether's hard metal.
- Industrial quartz: 4 quartz + 1 glowstone dust in the alloy smelter. For advanced circuits and solar panels.
- Soul fuel: 4 soul sand or soil + 1 coal in the alloy smelter = 2. Burns 8 times longer than coal, in furnaces and generators.

End (stability and the void):
- Voidnite ore (outer End islands, rare, diamond pickaxe): the strongest metal in the mod. Only a blast furnace smelts it. Its block resists explosions.
- Stable ender crystal: 1 ender pearl + 2 popped chorus fruit in the alloy smelter. For teleporting and long-range drones.
- Purpurite: the crusher grinds purpur blocks into dust; 4 dust + 1 lithium = 2 light ingots.
- Dragon essence: the dragon leaves 6 when it dies (every time you kill it), by the fountain. Also: 4 dragon's breath + 1 stable crystal. For the endgame.
- Chorus insulation: 4 chorus fruit + 1 plastic = 2.
tooltip.factorycraft.exoskeleton.help: Charged: strength, haste, speed, jump and no fall damage
tooltip.factorycraft.jetpack_mk2.help: Hold jump in the air to fly (stronger); sneak in the air to glide
guide.factorycraft.forge.title: Forge and gear
guide.factorycraft.forge.text:
Tool forge (power): a mould in the first slot (not used up), the material in the second and a part in the third: a circuit board for the electric tools (drill, multitool) or an iron gear for the rest.

Moulds: steel plates around the tool they copy (iron drill, hammer, chainsaw or excavating shovel; the multitool takes an advanced circuit). Material: 3 for drill, chainsaw and shovel, 5 for the hammer, 4 for the multitool.

Any metal or gem works, other mods' too: the tool gets that material's name, colour and stats (durability, speed, mining level and damage). Other mods' materials copy the stats of their own pickaxe.

Traits:
- Igneous crystal: smelts what it mines (iron comes out as ingots, sand as glass).
- Voidnite: hardly wears (60,000 uses), netherite level.
- Cobalt: very fast.
- Netherite, cobalt, igneous and voidnite don't burn in lava.

Multitool: pickaxe, axe, shovel and hoe in one, mining 3×3 (sneak: a single block).

Exoskeleton (chest piece, charged like the jetpack): strength, haste, speed and jump, and it absorbs falls. Holds 200,000.

Work suit (stainless steel and chorus insulation): each piece blocks 20% of radiation (80% for the full suit), the boots protect from contaminated soil and the full suit gives fire resistance.

Jetpack Mk II: triple battery, more thrust, and you glide by holding sneak in the air, with no fall damage.
message.factorycraft.pumpjack.dry: No oil here: try another chunk
guide.factorycraft.oil.title: Oil and advanced power
guide.factorycraft.oil.text:
Oil: some overworld chunks hold a deposit (4 in 10 have none). The pumpjack pumps crude canisters out of the chunk it stands in; the richer, the faster (at 100%, one every 10 seconds). Sneak + right-click with an empty hand shows how much there is.

Refinery: 1 crude = 1 diesel canister + 1 plastic sheet + 2 asphalt blocks.
- Diesel: burns 15 times longer than coal, in generators, furnaces and vehicles (vehicles take it from their bay by themselves).
- Asphalt: walking on it is 35% faster. The paver can pave with it.

Biofuel (clean): the fermenter turns 8 crops (sugar cane, wheat, potato, carrot, beetroot, melon, kelp, berries, apples, pumpkin) into a canister. Burns 7.5 times longer than coal and the diesel generator makes no smog burning it.

Hydro turbine: moving water makes power. Water falling on top: 40 per tick; water flowing beside it: 15 per side (max 100). Put them in waterfalls or along a river.

Advanced solar panel: 64 per tick in sunlight. Photon array: 256 by day and 64 at night. Rain cuts output to 40%, storms to a fifth.

Wireless charger: charges the electric tools, weapons and gear (drills, rifle, jetpack, exoskeleton...) of every player within 8 blocks, from the power network.
guide.factorycraft.farm.title: Farms and fluids
guide.factorycraft.farm.text:
Greenhouse controller: tends the farmland and plants around it (sneak + right-click: 9x9, 13x13 or 17x17, from 2 below to 3 above). It keeps the farmland wet, makes crops, saplings and other plants grow fast, harvests ripe crops into its 8 slots and replants them with their own seeds. 15 power per plant.

Animal farm: looks after the animals within 6 blocks. Put their food in its slots (wheat, seeds, carrots...) and it breeds pairs every 5 seconds, up to 16 of each kind. With shears it shears sheep; with empty buckets it milks cows. It picks up eggs, wool and anything else lying around.

Fluid tank: 32 buckets of any one fluid, from this mod or any other. Fill and empty it with buckets, the pump and pipes, or other mods' pipes. Stacked tanks drain into the one below. Right-click: shows what's inside.

Sewer grate: set it into the ground. It drains water standing on it, collects rain, and rubbish dropped on it falls into a chest or hopper below. The water goes into a tank below, or down the drain.

Desalinator: touching the sea (ocean or beach) it draws sea water by itself; elsewhere feed it water. Each bucket gives salt and half a bucket of fresh water, which it hands to the tanks and pipes beside it.

Salt: right-click snow or ice to melt a 5x5 patch. 2 rotten flesh + salt = leather. Other mods use it as c:dusts/salt.

Water treatment plant: washes the ground around it with water (a quarter bucket per block): contaminated soil becomes dirt again and smog-scorched coarse dirt turns back into grass. While it has water, it also protects its area from smog and fallout like an air purifier.

guide.factorycraft.transport.title: Storage and transport
guide.factorycraft.transport.text:
Storage terminal: links every inventory touching it or touching the data cables leading from it (chests, barrels, industrial chests, other mods' storage...) into one big searchable inventory. Left-click takes a stack, right-click half, shift-click straight to your inventory; click with an item (or shift-click it in your inventory) to store it. Plain storage is filled first; machines on the network only get what nothing else takes, and their outputs can be taken out.

Drone port: put drones in it (right-click with a delivery drone; sneak + empty hand takes one back). Link it with the wrench: click the sending port, then the receiving one (up to 512 blocks). Every 2 seconds a drone takes up to 4 stacks from the 6 cargo slots to the other port (400 power a trip). Deliveries land in the 8 output slots and are pushed out the front onto belts or into chests. The drone comes back by itself.

Cable car: place two stations (up to 160 blocks apart, any height) and right-click one, then the other, with a steel cable spool. A cabin runs back and forth, waiting 5 seconds at each end. Right-click it to ride (4 players), sneak to get off.

Cargo ship: fast on water (faster than any land vehicle), 27-slot hold. Loading and unloading stations on the quay work with it, and with the autopilot module it sails a route of beacons. It barely moves on land.

Garage: sneak + right-click it with an empty hand to park the nearest empty vehicle (within 8 blocks): it becomes its item with its cargo, modules and fuel. Parked vehicles get refuelled from the power network. Take them out of its screen and place them anywhere.

Sloped belts: a conveyor placed going up or down a step bends into a ramp by itself.

guide.factorycraft.defense.title: Defense and building
guide.factorycraft.defense.text:
Defense turret: shoots hostile mobs it can see within 20 blocks, twice a second (7 damage, 150 power a shot). It never aims at players or animals, and its kills drop experience as if you had made them.

Alarm: goes off when a hostile mob comes within 16 blocks, or another player (not who placed it) within 10. While it sounds it lights up and gives a redstone signal: use it to close shutters or switch on lamps.

Security cameras: place them looking where you want to watch. Link them with the wrench: click the camera, then the monitor (up to 8). Right-click the monitor to watch; jump changes camera, sneak goes back. Sneak + right-click the monitor unlinks them all.

Industrial shutter: a row of controllers above a doorway. A redstone signal on any of them rolls the steel shutter down to the floor (up to 12 blocks); without it, it rolls back up. The panels withstand any explosion.

Armored door: opens with redstone only, like an iron door, and nothing can blow it up.
Reinforced concrete: hard to break and resists normal explosions. Armor plating: resists everything, even mini-nukes.

Steel scaffolding: right-click a scaffold with more to build up the column (up to 64). Climb inside holding jump; stand on the deck on top. Breaking one brings down the ones above it.

Lift pad: a people elevator. Put one on each floor in the same column; on a pad, jump to go up to the next one and sneak to go down (up to 64 blocks).

Decoration: hazard stripes, steel panels, steel grate (see-through), industrial bricks and warning lamps.

guide.factorycraft.economy.title: Environment and economy
guide.factorycraft.economy.text:
Air quality: every chunk has a pollution level (0 to 1000), saved with the world. Smoke from generators burning dirty fuel and from incinerators raises it; so do reactor leaks and nuclear blasts. It clears by itself (about 700 points an hour), faster around air purifiers and water treatment plants. Check it with the air quality meter.
- 150+: a brown haze closes in, with drifting ash.
- 300+: animals walk away and aren't born there.
- 400+ and raining: acid rain. It kills leaves and flowers, sets crops back, scorches grass, and stings players without a helmet.
- 0: spotless air makes greenhouses 50% faster.

Recycler: takes crafted things apart (any crafting recipe, other mods' too). Each ingredient comes back 60% of the time, less for worn tools. Recycling also clears the air a little.

Vending machine: a shop that runs itself. Owner: first slot = price, second slot = goods, the next four = stock (hoppers can stock them). Others right-click holding the price to buy. Payments go to the outputs and out the front into a chest.

Contract board: three new industrial contracts every day. Deliver the goods by right-clicking with them (in parts if you like) and get paid in emeralds, sometimes diamonds, plus experience.

Statistics terminal: a chart of everything your machines have made, minute by minute, over the last half hour, with the top products.

Zone controller: protects the area around it (17×17, 33×33 or 65×65, full height). Only you and players carrying one of its access cards can build, break or open things there, and explosions do no damage. Bind a card by right-clicking the controller with it.

guide.factorycraft.endgame.title: Endgame
guide.factorycraft.endgame.text:
Particle accelerator: it needs at least 8 superconducting magnets connected to it, touching it or each other. More magnets make it faster: 8 halve the time, 32 make it 5 times faster. 250 power a tick. It fills containment cells with antimatter and transmutes: coal block → diamond, amethyst block → echo shard, ender pearl → stable ender crystal, glowstone → 2 industrial quartz.

Antimatter reactor: one antimatter cell = 4096 power a tick for 5 minutes (over 120 million in all), with no smoke and no waste.

Teleporter: link two pads with the wrench (one, then the other). They work both ways, even between dimensions. Right-click a pad to jump. 2000 power plus 2 per block, or 50 000 between dimensions.

Space program: the launch pad takes a rocket, a satellite and 8 rocket fuel (2 diesel + sulfur + blaze powder = 2 fuel). Sneak + right-click (or redstone) starts a 5-second countdown (20 000 power), and the rocket puts the satellite in orbit. The sky above the pad must be clear.
- Solar satellite: each one beams 256 power a tick to every orbital receiver (up to 4 satellites per receiver), day and night.
- Survey satellite: the satellite uplink reports the ores in your chunk, the richest oil within 8 chunks, and the air quality.
gui.factorycraft.research.title: Research Tree
gui.factorycraft.research.off: (research is turned off in the config: everything is available)
guide.factorycraft.research.title: Research
guide.factorycraft.research.text:
Advanced machines, vehicles and items must be researched before you can place or use them (you can still craft them). Basic machines (crusher, furnace, generator, conveyors, excavator, trucks...) are free.

Research station: put materials in it and it studies them into research points for the whole world (one item every 2 seconds, 60 power a tick). Advanced materials are worth more: an iron gear or steel ingot 1, a circuit board 4, an advanced circuit 12, voidnite 8, dragon essence 40, a nether star 100. Books, diamonds, emeralds and ender pearls count too.

Sneak + right-click the station (or /factorycraft research) opens the tree. Click a gold node to spend its points; a node needs the ones linked before it. Hover a node to see what it unlocks.

The tree: automation, electricity and advanced vehicles first; then terrain works, metallurgy, farms, oil, advanced power, cranes and aircraft; then logistics, economy, defense, power gear, nuclear power and photonics; then weapons, nuclear engines and the space program; and antimatter at the end.

Server owners can turn research off in the config (researchRequired = false).
